title: Sales Advisor (OMODA)
pay: £23,453 basic + uncapped commission & bonus + company car (average Sales Advisor earned £47.5k last year)
fit: Posted today (18 Nov) and says no motor trade experience is needed, with full training. Same package as the Allen MK role, and your Curve Media phone and email selling fits their enquiry-handling work.
desc: Handle inbound and outbound enquiries by phone, email and online at Allen's OMODA showroom in Northampton, guiding customers through the whole purchase including warranties, accessories and finance products, and following the rules for selling finance and insurance. Hit personal and team targets. They want a passion for customer service, selling and influencing skills, good communication, an understanding of the sales process and a full UK licence. Newcomers welcome, full training. 42-hour, 5-day week; company car; 30 days' holiday.
cover:
Hi Allen Motor Group recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Sales Advisor role at OMODA Northampton. My CV is attached.

I work at BCA in Bedford, handling dealership drop-offs and collections, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers, so I'm used to dealerships and to looking after customers' cars, including premium and performance models.

Before that I spent over a year in sales at Curve Media, generating my own leads by phone and email and closing premium packages with business owners and sports and music representatives. I haven't sold cars yet, but handling enquiries, following up and closing is what I did every day.

Your full training is exactly what I'm looking for to start my career in car sales.

Kind regards,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797
prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I work at BCA with dealerships every day – drop-offs, MOT and service movements, handovers – and before that I sold premium advertising packages at Curve Media from cold calls and emails. I haven't sold cars yet, but I can handle enquiries, follow up and close, and I want to learn properly with your training.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why car sales? You love the cars and dealership side at BCA; sales is the career you want.
• Tell me about a sale you closed. Pick a real Curve Media deal: how you found them, the objection, how you closed.
• How would you handle an online enquiry? Reply fast, call them, find their needs, book a test drive.
• What do you know about OMODA? Chery's newer brand – well-equipped SUVs (OMODA 5, electric E5) at value prices.
• How do you handle targets? Curve Media was target-driven; you ran your own pipeline.
• Weekends and a 42-hour week? Say yes if you can.

ASK THEM
• What does training cover in the first three months, including finance?
• How are enquiries shared across the team?

RESEARCH
OMODA 5 / E5 and JAECOO 7 range and prices; Allen's other Northampton sites (Ford, MAXUS). If you apply to Allen MK too, mention you'd be happy at either site.

title: Trainee sales role — direct approach

cover:
